title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → Student
description: Maps Ellucian Banner SIS tables to the HELIX Student resource.

source_tables.description: Person Biographical. Demographics, birth date, gender.
Student General. Student-level attributes, status, residency.
International Person. Citizenship, visa info for international students.
Additional Identification. Additional ID types (SSN, etc.)

attribute_mappings.transformation: Generate a deterministic UUID from institution_id + SPRIDEN_PIDM, or assign on first load
attribute_mappings.notes: PIDM is Banner's internal person key. Not exposed externally.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. This is the Banner student ID (e.g., '900123456')
attribute_mappings.notes: SPRIDEN_ID is the institution-assigned ID. SPRIDEN_PIDM is internal only.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Retain for internal cross-referencing.
attribute_mappings.notes: PIDM is the master key across all Banner tables.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Use current record (SPRIDEN_CHANGE_IND IS NULL).
Map Banner codes: 'M'→'male', 'F'→'female', 'N'→'nonbinary', null→'unknown'. Bind to helix/gender terminology.
attribute_mappings.notes: Banner 9.x added SPBPERS_GNDR_CODE for expanded gender identity. Prefer that if available.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Banner student status codes to HELIX: 'AS'→'enrolled', 'IS'→'leave_of_absence', 'EX'→'withdrawn'. Requires institution-specific code mapping.
attribute_mappings.notes: Use the most recent SGBSTDN record (max SGBSTDN_TERM_CODE_EFF).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Banner residency codes to HELIX enum: typically 'R'→'in_state', 'N'→'out_of_state', 'I'→'international'. Institution-specific.
attribute_mappings.notes: Banner residency codes are institution-defined in STVRESD.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Banner nation code (STVNATN) to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

attribute_mappings.notes: Availability depends on Banner version and institutional configuration.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Use the most recent activity date across source tables
